Who we are

The Company

Established in 2015, SRTEX BD has grown into a one-stop sourcing hub for the Ready-Made Garment (RMG) industry, built on more than 21 years of combined industry experience. We serve as a trusted sourcing partner for Apparel Manufacturing, Raw Materials Supply, and Quality Assurance Services.

Over the years, we have successfully handled production and supply chain operations for major international brands — deep industry knowledge, strong compliance expertise, and the ability to meet the demanding standards of world-class retailers and fashion labels.

What we do

One thread, five disciplines.

From raw material to finished trim, every service below is part of the same stitched-together sourcing process — apparel, fabric, and accessories, backed by quality and research.

Fabric Sourcing

Expert fabric selection through direct collaboration with mills and factories in China.

Apparel Sourcing

Woven, Knitwear and Sweaters for all end customers, with RSL-compliant kidswear.

Accessories Development

Buttons, laces, trims and 3D elements, certified to RSL, CPSIA and ISO benchmarks.

Quality Services

Multi-stage quality control from raw material to final production. Zero compromise.

Research & Development

Moisture-wicking, antibacterial and UV-protective textiles, built for performance.
